title: Product Comparison Configuration
description: Schema-driven configuration for the interactive product comparison overlay. Defines which fields are compared, how they are formatted, and which visualizations appear.

comparison_fields.description: Ordered list of fields to display as rows in the comparison grid.

format.description: Formatter applied to the resolved value.

higher_wins.description: If true, the largest value wins; if false, the smallest value wins. Used when highlight_winner is enabled.

max_compare.description: Maximum number of products that may be selected for comparison.

highlight_winner.description: When true, the winning value in each row is highlighted.

overlay_freq_curves.description: When true, an overlaid frequency-response chart is rendered if multiple products expose audio.frequency_response.

show_price_bar.description: When true, a horizontal price-comparison bar chart is rendered.
